mentions.name: Municipal issue report resolution tracker
mentions.description: A tool that monitors public reports on illegal dumping, broken streetlights, and other municipal issues, tracking how long the municipality takes to resolve them. Intended to present public data clearly and keep the city council accountable.
mentions.source_excerpt: Now working on a second tool that monitors public reports on illegal dumping, broken streetlights and more. It tracks how long the municipality takes to resolve them
